matched_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'SK Hynix cancels IPO of Solidigm unit'이다. SK Hynix Inc yesterday scrapped plans for a potential US$10 billion US listing of its Solidigm unit after facing strong opposition from regulators and shareholders, becoming the latest firm to pull an initial public offering (IPO) while growing investor unease over the artificial intelligence (AI). ” After the announcement, SK Hynix’s shares rose, defying a broad market slide triggered by a rout in US technology stocks The market value of SK Hynix’s Seoul-listed shares is about US$679 billion, about half of their June peak SK Hynix at the time said that Solidigm was reviewing options to improve its business competitiveness “In light of recent capital market conditions and share price trends, Solidigm determined that it was necessary to reassess whether an IPO would be the most beneficial option for SK Hynix and its existing shareholders at this time,” the company said in a statement Fibonacci Asset Management Global chief executive officer Jung In-yun said that the cancelation was positive for SK Hynix shareholders because it would ease concerns about dilution of the parent company’s economic interest in Solidigm, and the valuation discount associated with listing both a parent and its subsidiary. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

matched_articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 review – a thrilling airport novel of a game
matched_articles.summary: Korean Air 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 review – a thrilling airport novel of a game'이다. Activision; PC, PS5, Switch 2, Xbox From parkour over Manhattan rooftops and car chases in Paris to the climactic battle at a North Korean air base, the developers have thrown absolutely everything at the game And so we return perhaps one final time to Call of Duty’s Modern Warfare strand, with stories, “ripped from the newspaper headlines”, featuring shady terror organisations, nefarious rogue states and the brutally capable, monosyllabic war fighters who stand between us and Armageddon. Last year’s Black Ops 7 instalment was a sales disappointment for Activision, and that has no doubt put extra pressure on Infinity Ward, the studio leading Modern Warfare 4 development. Fortunately, this developer – like series heroes Price, Gaz and Ghost – seems to thrive on pressure. As you may have read , this year’s campaign is based around a fictitious North Korean ruling family that has seized an opportunity to invade its southern neighbour. Amid the chaos, a small group of Korean and American marines must help lead the fightback, while in the shadows, SAS hard man John Price makes an unlikely new comrade in his own morally ambiguous quest to put the world to rights. Mads Mikkelsen pops up as evil mastermind The Archer, but like Kiernan Shipka in Black Ops 7 he’s rather wasted, with very little screen time.
